tokens.name: cobalt-100
tokens.usage: Blue tint. Hover fill for soft primary surfaces; cover and illustration relief.

tokens.name: cobalt-200
tokens.usage: Pale blue. Text on dark primary-soft fills; illustration.

tokens.name: cobalt-300
tokens.usage: Light blue. Primary on dark grounds.

tokens.name: cobalt-500
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Primary on light grounds, the mark ink. White text on it is 5.5:1.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: Primary hover on light grounds.

tokens.name: cobalt-700
tokens.usage: Deep blue. Pressed primary, text on cobalt-50.

tokens.name: cobalt-900
tokens.usage: Darkest blue. Print covers, illustration depth.

tokens.name: sun-100
tokens.usage: Sunbeam tint. Warning-soft fill and highlight marks.

tokens.name: sun-300
tokens.usage: Light sunbeam. Accent hover.

tokens.name: sun-500
tokens.usage: Brand accent: accent buttons with ink text, the active-nav underline, the reading-progress bar, highlights. Not used in the logo. Never text on light grounds (1.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: sun-700
tokens.usage: Sunbeam dark enough for text on light grounds (5.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: walnut-600
tokens.usage: Workshop accent for the woodworking line: product tags, print stock details. 7.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: workshop-text
tokens.usage: Woodworking-line eyebrows, tags and labels on canvas and surface. 7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the top layer in dark mode, where elevation also lightens the surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, table headers, disabled fields.

tokens.name: surface-acrylic
tokens.usage: Translucent bars and sheets over content. Pair with backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders. Meets 3:1 on canvas, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders and meta on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover and primary-pressed.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft selected fills, chips, tonal buttons.

tokens.name: primary-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Tonal button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft and primary-soft-hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlights, the accent button, badges that call attention. Never as text on light grounds.

tokens.usage: Accent fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Sunbeam used as text or icon on canvas and surface.

tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.usage: Success text and icons on canvas and surface. Always paired with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and badge fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Paired with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and badge fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Paired with an icon and a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger alert and badge fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons. Steel cyan, so it reads apart from blue actions.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert and badge fill.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Reversed bands: footers, banners, the reversed lockup ground. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse-surface: footer notes, meta. 8.4:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the inline logo on the current theme: ink on light, white on dark. Metallic logo colors are separate tones.

tokens.name: mark-bar
tokens.usage: Retired with the v1 mark (the logo no longer carries sunbeam). Kept for the cover illustration and older files.

tokens.name: metal-gold
tokens.usage: Gold logo color, from the brand file. Dark grounds only: 7.5:1 on navy, 2.4:1 on white. Logo, foil, engraving fills and premium print; not for text.

tokens.name: metal-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze logo color. Light and cream grounds: 5.4:1 on white, only 3.4:1 on navy.

tokens.name: metal-rose-gold
tokens.usage: Rose-gold logo color. Dark grounds only: 6.3:1 on navy, 2.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: metal-silver
tokens.usage: Silver logo color. Dark grounds only: 10.9:1 on navy, 1.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and inputs.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Hovered interactive cards, sticky bars.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: elev-4
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

duration.note: Motion is quick and settles softly. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop movement, keep fades at duration-fast.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, page-level transitions.
